'''Voushon''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who worked for small-time crime lord [[Big Bunji/Legends|Big Bunji]]. Voushon was said to have more morals than most smugglers, and he took up the job knowing that few people would get hurt. He could speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] fluently, albeit with a nasal and squeaky tone.<ref name="There's Many a Slip Betwixt Cup and Lip" />
